changelog: Adds a scheduled task that re-reads every account's watch history and folds anything new into their taste profile. It appears under Dashboard, Scheduled Tasks as 'Import Jellyfin watch history', runs once a day by default, and the schedule is editable there or can be run on demand. Live capture already sees ordinary viewing, so this is reconciliation: it catches what was watched while the server or plugin was down, bulk mark-as-played edits, accounts added since the last scan, and ratings or favourites the engine did not see change. Repeating it is cheap because each run replaces its own previous rows rather than adding to them, so a daily schedule cannot inflate anyone's history. This is a beta release.
